statusDetail: Coverage-complete public logged-out audit. Registration was bot-challenged, so the accessible login route represented account entry; paid/account-internal and authenticated gameplay were not covered.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-route application with client-side interactive surfaces
page.notes: Large public chess application. Representative logged-out routes cover landing, gameplay, puzzles, learning, authentication, and HTTP error recovery.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Light and dark captures are byte-identical; the root remains dark and computed color-scheme is dark under both preferences.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and probed animations/media playback.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The hero video retained autoplay=true and was actively playing at 5.15s with reduced motion requested.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured forced-colors: active plus prefers-contrast: more.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text, controls, borders, and all three consent actions remain visible in forced colors.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected public navigation links and captured destination states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary navigation performs ordinary full-document route changes and no View Transition use was observed in the accessible styles or DOM.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the tested routes for scroll-linked storytelling, parallax, and reveal behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked animation surface was present on the representative logged-out routes, so there is no scroll animation implementation to judge.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation surface was present on the representative logged-out routes, so there is no scroll animation implementation to judge.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised the logged-out puzzle and computer-board surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested primary interactions are chess-square selection and buttons, not custom pull, swipe, carousel, or overscroll gestures requiring this technique.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested primary interactions are chess-square selection and buttons, not custom pull, swipe, carousel, or overscroll gestures requiring this technique.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared desktop and mobile page screenshots and inspected navigation landmarks.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation remains compact and available while page content receives the majority of the viewport; no harmful static overlaying chrome was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected open dialogs and tested navigation surfaces near viewport edges.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or anchor-attached popover was exposed in the representative logged-out paths; the overlays encountered were modal dialogs, not anchored UI.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or anchor-attached popover was exposed in the representative logged-out paths; the overlays encountered were modal dialogs, not anchored UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured the puzzle entry state and completed its introductory step.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The active Puzzles section, board, centered introduction, and single “Ok” action clearly cue where attention moved.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured first-load screenshots across homepage and puzzle routes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A consent wall occupies nearly the full viewport on every fresh load; on Puzzles it appears simultaneously with a second introductory modal and obscures the task.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlay DOM and exercised dismiss controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The puzzle introduction uses native <dialog>; consent exposes role=dialog and explicit Accept, Reject All, and Privacy Settings controls, and both can be dismissed.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually reviewed homepage, Learn, and post-dismissal puzzle states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After interruption dismissal, content and the chess board dominate the viewport; navigation chrome is compact and visually subordinate.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran layout metrics at 360x800 on homepage and computer board.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both routes report scrollWidth=clientWidth=360, horizontalOverflowPx=0, and a viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared shared navigation, content cards, and game surfaces at desktop and mobile widths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Shared components recompose to the available space and the board stays within its container on both tested routes; cross-origin stylesheet rules limited direct @container inspection.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured rendered control targets and inspected keyboard-relevant controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Multiple footer links render only 18px high, below a comfortable touch target; the mobile menu control is also unnamed.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewport headings and calls to action on homepage, Learn, and Puzzles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage names the service and exposes Get Started, Lesson, Bot, Puzzle, and Watch actions; each destination has a specific title and task.

checkOutcomes.method: Dismissed the two first-load dialogs and entered the logged-out puzzle board.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After selecting Ok and Reject All, the puzzle board is present and ready without requiring an account.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested a nonexistent route and inspected the result.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site returns a branded “404 Page not found” state with a clear Return Home recovery link.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse and a DevTools performance trace.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.6s and TBT 260ms; the independent trace measured LCP 3.09s. Both exceed the good LCP threshold.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts on homepage and computer board.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage CLS was 0 and the computer route accumulated only 0.0013 CLS, with no horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Used Lighthouse main-thread diagnostics and trace long tasks.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports 2.6s of main-thread work and 260ms TBT; the trace also observed a 51.4ms long task.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR, inspected parser-inserted stylesheets, and corroborated with Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transfers 4,044,788 bytes across 159 requests and 28 stylesheets; Lighthouse estimates 910ms render-blocking savings and flags cache/LCP discovery.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed Lighthouse code diagnostics and HAR resource composition.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1,167KiB unused JavaScript and 31KiB unused CSS; the HAR records 89 script requests totaling 2.71MB.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and a DOM control-name probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile navigation expand button has no accessible name; the DOM probe found two unlabeled mobile toolbar buttons.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse color-contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent Accept and Reject buttons use white text on #81b64c at 2.4:1, below the required 4.5:1 for their text size.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected heading/landmark structure and Lighthouse accessibility output.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The DOM begins with duplicate Search H2 headings before the sole H1, and Puzzles exposes duplicate H1s, weakening a logical outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually inspected text at desktop, mobile, Learn, login, and forced-color conditions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body text remains readable without clipping; lines reflow on mobile and forced-color text stays visible.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected viewport policy, narrow reflow, media, and target dimensions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow succeeds without horizontal overflow, but multiple footer targets are only 18px high, so target sizing remains deficient.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse console-error audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The browser-errors audit passed with no logged console errors or uncaught exceptions.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected doctype/charset and ran image/Lighthouse asset audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Document basics pass, but one image lacks complete dimensions, eight are oversized, and six lack responsive srcset; Lighthouse also flags unsized images.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices/Inspector Issues diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Chrome reports unresolved cookie issues in the Issues panel; the best-practices score is 0.77.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered and raw metadata on homepage and Learn.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both routes preserve descriptive titles, H1s, and meta descriptions in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected anchor hrefs, viewport metadata, robots.txt, and Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation uses real hrefs, viewport metadata is present, robots.txt is valid, and Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected canonical, hreflang, HTTP status, robots, and sitemap declaration.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage returned 200 with canonical https://www.chess.com/; robots permits public routes and declares sitemapindex.xml; Lighthouse hreflang/robots audits pass.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected social-preview metadata and visible content.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Open Graph and Twitter title, description, URL, and large image accurately describe the public homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers and cookies primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff, and frame protection are present, but CSP only restricts frame-ancestors and six cookies lack Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and enumerated trackers/third-party origins.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Fresh load contacts seven third-party origins, loads consent/vendor infrastructure, and transfers 4.0MB; Sentry is identified as a known tracking/telemetry origin.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the login flow, autocomplete attributes, page text, and auth markup.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Login supports passwords and federated identity but exposes no passkey/WebAuthn option; no permission prompt fired on load.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected main-document security headers and cookie posture.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent, CSP provides no script-src/Trusted Types defense, and SameSite=None cookies are set.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared browser-rendered and no-JavaScript crawler views.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Learn route exposes only 6% of rendered content without JavaScript and is classified as a JS shell; its crawler screenshot is essentially blank content chrome.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised dialogs and inspected edge behavior at desktop/mobile sizes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dialogs remain visible and dismissible, puzzle state proceeds after dismissal, and no overflow or blank runtime state appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Fetched the web app manifest and checked active service-worker control.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A valid standalone manifest exists, but the page has no service-worker controller, so this app-like site lacks an observed offline fallback.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested a nonexistent HTTP route.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 404 state is explicit and offers a Return Home action rather than a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected root language/direction and language controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document declares lang=en-US and dir=ltr and exposes a Change Language control.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative rendered pages and locale controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested English locale presents localized text and a language switcher; no malformed hand-built date, number, or currency formatting appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed the representative homepage, learning, puzzle, and login paths for time-sensitive data.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited states do not display scheduled times or time-zone-sensitive event data, so time-zone arithmetic is not applicable to these paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited states do not display scheduled times or time-zone-sensitive event data, so time-zone arithmetic is not applicable to these paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed consent, login, and puzzle entry states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent offers equally prominent Accept and Reject All actions; login exposes recovery and sign-up links without disguised commitments.

checkOutcomes.method: Submitted the empty login form after rejecting consent.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Required fields use native validation messages and the page adds a visible “Please complete the security check to continue” recovery message.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected login field labels and autocomplete tokens.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Visible username/email and password controls have accessible names and use email/current-password autocomplete; Remember me is explicitly labelled.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed the accessible logged-out account entry surface.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Login clearly separates password and federated options, includes Forgot Password, and labels sign-up as a separate next step without hidden pricing.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image audit and reviewed HAR image delivery.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Eight images are oversized, six lack srcset, and Lighthouse estimates 142KiB image-delivery savings.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed network composition and Lighthouse code-usage diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial logged-out page ships 89 scripts while Lighthouse estimates 1,167KiB unused JavaScript, indicating avoidable work.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and probed media under reduced motion.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 4.0MB load includes a 450KB autoplay hero video and substantial consent/third-party code before user action.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered DOM, forms, and exposed browser capabilities for agent tool registration.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Agent-facing tool exposure is emerging and Chess.com does not declare an intent to expose gameplay/account actions to agents; absence is treated as an opportunity, not a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: Agent-facing tool exposure is emerging and Chess.com does not declare an intent to expose gameplay/account actions to agents; absence is treated as an opportunity, not a failure.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected public page scripts/capability probes for built-in AI surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No user-facing summarization or language-model task exists on the audited paths, so on-device inference is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user-facing summarization or language-model task exists on the audited paths, so on-device inference is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap summaries before and after ten puzzle settings open/close attempts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap self size rose only 322,955 bytes (0.24%) and node count 12,219 (0.62%), which is bounded under this short repeated interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured a V8 heap summary on the interactive puzzle page.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The post-interaction footprint is 135,736,202 self-size bytes across 1,977,075 nodes, high for a single logged-out puzzle surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap type/constructor summaries before and after repeated interaction.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appears among dominant retained constructors and total growth stayed below 1%; no accumulation signal was observed in this bounded run.

paths.description: Public landing page and global navigation; represents marketing/content shell and global privacy UI.
Landing page at 360x800; represents narrow reflow and touch layout.
Play against computer; represents interactive game-board layout.
Logged-out puzzle journey; represents board interaction, onboarding dialogs, and repeated settings interaction.
Learning index; represents content/listing discoverability and no-JavaScript resilience.
Login route; represents authentication, form assistance, invalid submission, and recovery.
Nonexistent route; represents HTTP error and recovery state.

Registration route was sampled but Cloudflare bot verification blocked the form; login was used as the representative account-entry form. Authenticated, paid, account-management, live-game, and checkout surfaces remain outside this logged-out representative set.

findings.summary: Consent obscures the homepage on every fresh visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile first-load screenshots show the consent panel occupying nearly the entire usable viewport before core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent surface for optional processing; keep Reject All immediately available and defer non-essential vendors until a choice.

findings.summary: Puzzles stacks two blocking dialogs at once.
findings.evidence: The Puzzles screenshot shows a centered introduction dialog while the consent dialog simultaneously spans the bottom and dims the board.
findings.suggestedFix: Sequence onboarding only after consent is resolved, or remove the redundant onboarding interruption and let users begin directly.

findings.summary: Theme does not follow the system color preference.
findings.evidence: Emulated light and dark screenshots are identical and the root remains color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare supported color schemes and map tokens through prefers-color-scheme/light-dark(), while preserving an explicit user override.

findings.summary: Autoplay hero media continues under reduced motion.
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the video is autoplaying and not paused at 5.15 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable autoplay or replace moving hero media with a static poster under reduced motion, with an explicit play control.

findings.summary: Mobile menu controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies the mobile toolbar expand button, and the DOM probe finds two unlabeled toolbar buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Add concise aria-label values such as “Open menu” and “Close menu”, preserving button semantics.

findings.summary: Several tap targets are too short.
findings.evidence: DOM measurement finds footer links with rendered target heights of 18px and a vendor button at 20.8px.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the clickable area to at least 24px, preferably 44 CSS px, using padding without shrinking visible spacing.

findings.summary: Consent action text fails color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse computes 2.4:1 for white text on #81b64c for both Accept and Reject All, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the green button background or use a darker text color so normal-size labels reach 4.5:1.

findings.summary: Heading outlines contain duplicates and pre-H1 headings.
findings.evidence: Homepage DOM has two Search H2 elements before its H1; Puzzles exposes two H1 elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep one page H1, hide inactive duplicate UI from the accessibility tree, and place Search labels in an appropriate landmark rather than heading rank.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow and main-thread work is elevated.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 4.6s, TBT 260ms, and 2.6s main-thread work; trace LCP is 3.09s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP candidate, defer non-critical consent/configuration bundles, and split post-load work into prioritized tasks.

findings.summary: Initial delivery is heavy and render-blocking.
findings.evidence: HAR records 159 requests, 4.04MB transferred, 28 stylesheets, and 89 scripts; Lighthouse estimates 910ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, consolidate/defer route CSS, preload only the true LCP resource, and postpone non-essential vendor scripts.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 1,167KiB unused JavaScript and 31KiB unused CSS; scripts account for 2.71MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Use route/component code splitting and conditional async loading for consent, monitoring, and features not needed for the logged-out first view.

findings.summary: Image sizing and responsive delivery are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Image audit finds one missing dimension, eight oversized assets, and six images without srcset; Lighthouse estimates 142KiB savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height, generate srcset/sizes variants, and select image dimensions close to rendered size.

findings.summary: Chrome reports unresolved Inspector Issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices is 0.77 and records cookie-related Issues panel entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the reported cookie posture and rerun DevTools Issues/Lighthouse until no browser issues remain.

findings.summary: The response lacks a complete browser defense policy.
findings.evidence: CSP is only “frame-ancestors self”; Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent, though HSTS/nosniff/frame protection pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP covering scripts and other resource types, plus explicit Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Six first-party cookies omit Secure.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit marks me, ATTRIBUTION_V1, visitorid, and OptanonConsent among six cookies without Secure; SameSite=None also appears.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, review SameSite=None necessity, and keep session/auth-like values HttpOnly.

findings.summary: Fresh load has a broad third-party/consent footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker scan sees seven third-party origins including Sentry; consent/vendor resources are among the largest and slowest requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Block optional analytics and vendor requests until consent, minimize vendor list/config downloads, and batch necessary telemetry.

findings.summary: Authentication offers no phishing-resistant passkey path.
findings.evidence: Login markup and visible text provide password and federated providers but no passkey or WebAuthn option.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and sign-in, including conditional mediation where supported, while retaining existing recovery methods.

findings.summary: Learn is effectively empty without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability reports 6% raw-content coverage and classifies /learn as a JS shell; the crawler screenshot contains only navigation chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the lesson categories and primary links, then hydrate enhancements so core learning content remains useful without JavaScript.

findings.summary: The app manifest has no observed offline service-worker control.
findings.evidence: manifest.json defines standalone installability, but navigator.serviceWorker.controller is false.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a conservative service worker with an offline shell/fallback and cache only stable, privacy-safe core assets.

findings.summary: Autoplay media and vendor payload inflate the initial resource budget.
findings.evidence: A 450KB hero WebM is fetched and autoplayed before interaction; total transfer is 4.04MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a static poster by default, load/play video after intent or when visible, and defer consent/vendor payloads until required.

findings.summary: The logged-out puzzle heap is large.
findings.evidence: Post-interaction heap summary contains 1,977,075 nodes and 135,736,202 self-size bytes, despite small growth during the repeated action.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile dominant native/code allocations, unload route-only modules and canvas resources, and set a memory budget for the puzzle surface.

findings.summary: Primary route changes do not provide continuity.
findings.evidence: Public nav uses ordinary destination links and no View Transition integration was observed across the captured homepage, Learn, and Puzzles states.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document view transitions for same-origin navigation, respecting reduced motion and keeping transitions subtle.

taskList.title: Remove or sequence first-load blocking dialogs
Cut LCP, render-blocking CSS, and initial JavaScript
Strengthen CSP, browser policies, and cookie flags
Server-render the Learn route core content
Fix accessible names, contrast, targets, and headings
Minimize third-party and autoplay resource use
Respect system theme and reduced-motion preferences
Add an offline fallback and reduce puzzle heap
